comment: C ref: dog.c mon_arrive():584-592 picks a spot in the first room in_rooms() reports, through svr.rooms[*r - ROOMOFFSET], which also holds subrooms. In this Minetown variant the shops are subrooms. The hero steals from the hardware store and level-teleports away with its keeper adjacent, pays him off, and returns; the keeper migrates home with MIGR_APPROX_XY to his shop door, where in_rooms() lists the shop subroom first, so mon_arrive() calls somexy() on the shop. Seed, clock and character chosen independently; the seed was picked for a Minetown with nested shop rooms.
